appName: OowOah VR Meeting Room & Quantum Leap
displayName: OowOah VR Meeting Room & Quantum Leap
display_name: OowOah VR Meeting Room & Quantum Leap
display_long_description:
Step into a fully immersive VR meeting experience with OowOah — built to go beyond traditional platforms like Zoom and Teams. OowOah places you inside a true virtual meeting room where you can connect, collaborate, and present as if you were physically together.

Key features include full-size presentation screens for impactful presentations, AI-powered main meeting notes that automatically capture key points, and personal note-taking tools so every participant can track their own ideas. Navigate naturally in VR, interact with others in real time, and stay fully engaged without the limitations of flat screens.

OowOah also includes organisation and team management, the ability to run multiple meetings, and scalable meeting spaces based on your needs. With the unique Quantum Leap feature, you can bring real-world environments into the meeting, creating powerful remote collaboration experiences.

Designed for Meta Quest headsets, OowOah removes the need for travel while delivering a far more engaging, focused, and productive way to meet.

To set up your business account go to   https://www.oowoah.com and click set up account.
